image_description: A low-angle shot of a weathered street sign assembly against a clear blue sky. The signs are mounted on a thick, textured concrete or wooden pole. There are two main rectangular signs intersecting at an angle; they appear to be rusted metal with white lettering that is heavily distorted and illegible (gibberish). A smaller green sticker or sign fragment is visible between them. The structure shows signs of age and corrosion.
